positions.name: SensorRolloutPlanAndCadence
positions.frame: How should the greenhouse humidity sensor rollout be sequenced and timed so it catches the conditions that cost seedlings last winter?
positions.why: Odile's plan (install in all four bays before first frost, pilot in bay two because of last winter's losses) and Pell's reporting-interval claim (fifteen minutes, to catch the overnight drop) both answer one question: how to set up the rollout so it protects against the earlier loss. Pell's 'Agreed.' ratifies the install plan. The set holds no real tension. The install-and-pilot decision is argued from past loss, and the cadence is argued from its consequence for what the sensors can see.
